name: Protected health information: Safe Harbor removal, approved models, minimum necessary
description: Keeps protected health information out of model calls that are not approved for it, out of outputs, and out of decision records except the erasable vault.
limits: Detects the Safe Harbor identifiers that have a textual pattern, plus names passed in from structured data. Names, relatives and employers in free text are not reliably found by patterns: pair PHI-1 with the PHI reader adapter (D13), whose findings are judged by checks. Photographs and biometric identifiers are out of scope. Not reviewed by counsel or the clinical safety lead.

frameworks.title: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR Part 164, Subpart E)

hazards.title: Identifiable health information disclosed to an unapproved processor or in an output

controls.title: Safe Harbor identifiers removed from outputs
controls.requirement: Text leaving the agent (outputs, summaries, anything written in clear in a record) contains none of the identifiers the Safe Harbor method lists that this pack detects.

controls.title: Only models approved for PHI receive it
controls.requirement: A model receives protected health information only if it is on the organisation's approved-for-PHI list at the exact version listed.

controls.title: Minimum necessary fields
controls.requirement: Only the fields the stated purpose needs are sent to a model or kept in an output.

controls.title: Expert determination on file when used
controls.requirement: Data de-identified by the expert-determination method instead of Safe Harbor has a current determination on file naming the expert, the method and its expiry.

controls.title: PHI stays out of records except the vault
controls.requirement: The agent runs in regulated mode, so prompts, sources, model answers and inputs go to the erasable vault and the record keeps only their hashes.
